subject: Azure marketplace commit proposal & reseller margin for Sparrow Health
messages:
From: Claire Huang <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@cloudbridge.io
Date: 2027-04-18T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sparrow Health private offer — commitment sizing and channel margin

Hi Aditya,

Following up from our call this morning — Sparrow Health (procurement attached) is interested in a 12–18 month private offer on Azure marketplace. They’re targeting an annualized commitment of ~$450k in list price. Two asks from our side:

- Guidance on reseller/partner margin for CloudBridge (they want to be able to resell through the partner program).
- Whether Redwood can accept a slight list price adjustment for marketplace listing (we can route via private offer SKU).

If you can share a simple margin waterfall and any constraints (max commission, retro credits, or minimums) I’ll coordinate with the CloudBridge team and procurement.

Thanks,
Claire Huang
Azure Marketplace — Strategic Partnerships
Microsoft Corporation

Attachment: procurement_sparrow_health.pdf (stub)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sparrow Health private offer — commitment sizing and channel margin

Hi Claire — thanks for the note and context. Looping in Vanessa (partner ops) and Marissa (finance) to confirm acceptable reseller margins and any PO constraints from our side.

Initial thoughts: we typically support channel margins in the 10–15% range for marketplace private offers, with a carve-out for onboarding acceleration. That said, we want to avoid open-ended retro credits. Vanessa/Marissa — can you weigh in with a recommended structure and any documentation we should share (I can also attach our PO template).

Aditya
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sparrow Health private offer — commitment sizing and channel margin

Thanks Aditya — quick partner ops read:

- Recommend base reseller margin = 12% of net list (paid as commission to CloudBridge).
- For partner enablement (first 6 months) we can offer a one-time uplift to 15% for deals that close within 90 days of listing, capped to the first $75k of ARR.
- No open-ended retro rebates. If we offer attainment-based uplift, structure as a "performance rebate" payable after invoice verification (90 days post-quarter).

I attached a simple waterfall calc that shows cost to us at different commit bands (assumes 30% gross margin target). If finance signs off we can send the PO template and a DocuSign link.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partner Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: reseller_margin_calc.xlsx (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sparrow Health private offer — commitment sizing and channel margin

Agree with Vanessa but with two asks from finance:

1) Cap total partner commissions + rebates at 18% of committed ARR over the life of the PO. We don’t want the effective net price to dip below our minimum list.
2) Require a signed PO (Azure private offer) and a single invoice schedule tied to the commitment. Any rebates paid after attainment should be contingent on proof of payment and partner invoice reconciliation.

If those constraints look ok to partner ops, we can send the Azure_PO_Template_v3.pdf and route to legal for a short addendum.

Marissa Cole
VP, Finance — Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Azure_PO_Template_v3.pdf (stub)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>, partners@cloudbridge.io
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed terms for Sparrow Health private offer (summary)

Claire / CloudBridge team — thanks for your patience while we reviewed internally. Below is the proposed structure Redwood can accept for the $450k annualized commitment. If this is acceptable we’ll route the Azure private offer via DocuSign and provide the PO template.

Proposed commercial outline:
- Commitment: 12-month private offer, contract value $450,000 list price (Sparrow Health).
- Channel commission: 12% of list paid to CloudBridge on invoiced amounts.
- Onboarding uplift: 15% commission for CloudBridge on first $75k recognized ARR if the deal is signed within 90 days of listing.
- Rebate mechanics: any attainment-based uplift paid as a performance rebate (paid once per quarter following invoice reconciliation).
- Finance guardrails: total partner commissions + rebates capped at 18% of committed ARR. Payment of rebates contingent on partner invoices and proof of customer payment.

Next steps:
1) If CloudBridge + Sparrow are OK, Claire please confirm and share procurement contact for Sparrow — we’ll send the Azure_PO_Template_v3.pdf and DocuSign flow.
2) We’ll route a short addendum (1 page) for the rebate and cap language to legal.
3) Vanessa/Marissa/Karthik — please confirm you’re comfortable with the above and I’ll hit send externally.

Aditya Rao
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Azure_PO_Template_v3.pdf (stub); reseller_margin_calc.xlsx (stub)
